data_fields.name: maxSeriesPerName
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (Frankendom choice, suggested start 64)

best_idea: A metric store that refuses new label combinations past a per-name cap, counts the refusal, and reports series counts once a minute, plus a timed wait that always records its duration.
decision_why: Frankendom has no metrics surface to guard; the shape (bounded labels, per-name cap with drop counter, once-a-minute series count, zero filter, slow-only log, per-call-site wait budget) is cheap on a small Node server. Donor lacks a cap and misses the finally on failed waits; both are fixed in the sketch. Kamon and the full Prometheus exposition are not taken.
acceptance: A server test records 500 distinct player-id labels on one metric name with cap N and asserts N series are stored and dropped equals 500 minus N; a second test makes a wait time out and asserts blocking.timeout and blocking.time_ms each record once.
